name: Speech Playground
summary: Type anything and hear it read aloud in Apple's most natural voices, or your own Personal Voice, on iPhone. Tune speed and pitch, follow each word as it is spoken, and save the speech as audio. Everything stays on the device.

screenshots.alt: Speech Playground on iPhone reading a short story aloud, the spoken word highlighted, with the Ava Premium voice picked and speed and pitch sliders below

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Play the speech through the speaker or headphones, lowering other audio while it talks
With your permission, speak in the Personal Voice you set up in Accessibility settings
Save the speech as an audio file and hand it to the share sheet when you ask
